reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: Ken Jinks
reviews.text: Wayne’s Tree Service did an outstanding job. The team was courteous, professional, and incredibly hardworking from start to finish. They took great care to protect my property, worked safely and efficiently, and left everything clean when they were done. Their attention to detail and respect for our home really stood out. I highly recommend Wayne’s Tree Service to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality tree work.

reviews.author: viktor misko
reviews.text: Wayne Tree Service was a pleasure to work with from start to finish. Their pricing was very fair for the work involved, and the whole process, starting from the estimate to the cleanup, the whole thing was simple and stress-free. Dylan was excellent at communicating, walking us through the plan, and making sure everything happened exactly as promised. Pete did a fantastic job on-site, working safely, efficiently, and leaving the yard spotless when they were done. I’d happily use Wayne Tree Service again and highly recommend Dylan and Pete to anyone needing tree work!

reviews.author: David Puntillo
reviews.text: This is the third time we have used Wayne’s. They are very professional. Great communication, on time, great price. The guys work quickly, clean up the job site, and keep you up to date on the progress of the work. I would recommend they be your first call for all tree cutting/removal needs.

reviews.author: John McLaughlin
reviews.text: The team was great. Dylan helped me decide on a tree to replace existing birch and took the time to find the best one from multiple nurseries. Team took down the birch and had the new tree up quickly and the work area was totally clean after they left. Thank you!

reviews.author: Denise Van Horn
reviews.text: I have used Wayne’s Tree Service several times for pruning trees and tree removal. They respond promptly to give an estimate which I have found to be very reasonable. Work is done on a timely basis with little to no disruption to the rest of your yard. I would definitely recommend this company.

reviews.author: Lib Martino
reviews.text: I had a diseased Maple Tree removed from my property. The work was done quickly and cleanly by a terrific crew. I greatly appreciated that although the tree was in close proximity to the mailbox and a bed of daffodils, not a single leaf was damaged... I'd recommend Wayne's Tree Service without hesitation to anyone looking to have a job completed by terrific professionals.

reviews.author: Kris Knudson
reviews.text: Wayne's Tree Service was recently used to clear a massive blockage in Royce Brook that has caused us major headaches with flooding in previous years. They did a tremendous job and the blockage was totally removed which will allow the proper flow of water during heavy rainfalls, major storms and hurricanes. I've used Wayne's Tree Service several times myself in the past and they NEVER disappointed me! I recommend them to anyone looking for quality tree work of any kind. See for yourself...you will be extremely pleased with their service.

reviews.author: Dan Iannelli
reviews.text: Sent in a request for an estimate to remove a large maple in my front yard and Dylan was quick to respond. He came out same day, explained what needed to be done, and gave a very fair price. I accepted and he came out the next day to do the job. The crew was efficient and clean and completed the job in just over an hour. Would highly recommend Dylan and team!

reviews.author: Kevin DeStefano
reviews.text: Excellent job start to finish. Quick and responsive in estimate and scheduling. Took down a large maple, ground the stump and removed all debris except for a wood chip pile which will be useful for gardening/compost. Also removed a small dogwood right up against the house. Work was done efficiently and got the job done in only a few hours. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Susan Franciose
reviews.text: Wayne’s tree service did a phenomenal job and the price was very reasonable. I would tell anyone who needs tree service that this is the business that you should use. Very professional, and very reasonable. I included before and after pictures.

reviews.author: Michael Kelly
reviews.text: Wayne’s did a great job removing a huge maple tree from our yard. They were very easy to work with, communicated effectively, worked around our schedule, and gave a fair price. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: JoAnn
reviews.text: Dylan and his entire crew are outstanding. I needed a large dead pine tree taken down ASAP because it was next to my house and overhead wires. Dylan responded immediately and quoted me a very reasonable price. The guys had this tree taken down so quick and efficiently, removed all of the wood and my yard was cleaner than when they arrived. Top notch crew and service! Highly recommend using Wayne’s Tree Service..very professional and friendly!!

reviews.author: Kevin O'Brien
reviews.text: Very happy with Wayne’s tree service. The estimate was quick and easy, and the work was performed in a timely manner. I wasn’t home during the service, and came back to a pleasant surprise of no mess! After pruning of a 20+ foot tree, and removal/stump grinding of another medium sized tree the job was done exactly as discussed. Thank you!

reviews.author: James Basilone
reviews.text: Wayne's Tree Service removed a large tree from my backyard that was dangerously leaning toward my house last year. They did an absolutely fantastic job! The team was super fast, efficient, and nice. They handled everything professionally, from the initial assessment to the final clean-up. I would 100% recommend Wayne's Tree Service to anyone in the area looking for tree removal. If you need a quick, reliable, and friendly service, look no further!

reviews.author: Eileen Bowers
reviews.text: Dylan and team are knowledgeable and professional and always respectful of our property. They have assisted us on several tree projects---from tree removal to pruning. We are always satisfied with the work completed. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Helen Kyritsis
reviews.text: I have used Wayne’s Tree Service on a few occasions. Dylan responded immediately and set up an appointment to discuss and survey what I needed to get done. I’m on an acre with several trees that are aging. Dylan was able to survey which trees needed to be taken care of immediately and gave me suggestions on how I could do things one step at a time. An entire crew came in and worked diligently, carefully, and left my yard clean and intact. I would recommend Wayne’s Tree Service and will continue to use him for my next project.

reviews.author: Colleen Runyon
reviews.text: I have used Wayne's tree service a couple of separate times over the years and have been extremely satisfied with their work each time. Dylan is eat to work with and responds to questions promptly. They were quick, efficient and thorough with all the tree removals. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Melody McKenzie
reviews.text: These guys were awesome!! I called on a Saturday, had a quote Monday morning and they removed our trees by Wednesday! They worked so hard, made sure they cleaned my yard, and l couldn't be happier. Such nice guys, couldn't recommend them more!

reviews.author: Henry Duncan
reviews.text: Contacted Wayne's Tree Service to remove a small tree in my front yard along with with some other potential larger removals. They were responsive as to requests, scheduling and removal where others did not even respond or show up. When they did the removal they showed up with a large crew, took care of it very quickly and cleaned up well. I would clearly recommend Wayne's and will use them again for future needs.

reviews.author: Megan Britton
reviews.text: Came quick and finished the job early. Cleaned up our overgrowth in the front and back yard. We can see our house now! Good communication and nice guys! Appreciate their work!

reviews.author: DLD
reviews.text: I contacted Wayne's Tree Service via their website for a quote, Bonnie got back to me within 30-minutes. Bonnie was not sure if they did work in my area, but I saw on their website they did so she scheduled an appointment for me. Unfortunately, whoever set up their website incorrectly indicated too many areas they work in and Bonnie called me back roughly 5-10-minutes after the appointment schedule to say she was sorry, but they do not work in my area. While I am very disappointed, I understood and thanked her for her diligence. I have contacted many alleged tree services to prune and shape my two trees and they either do not get back or ghost me after providing a quote. This was not my experience with Wayne's Tree Service, they at least were honest and communicative, which I appreciate. So without ever having used this company I would highly recommend them for their upfront honesty.

reviews.author: Gavin Millard
reviews.text: I had a very large tree fall down on my property due to a windstorm and Wayne's came by the same day I called to give me a price and then showed up the next morning to do the job. I have been using Wayne's for many years and they do not disappoint. If ever there is a small issue, they will make it right. A wonderful local business and an incredibly professional and skilled work crew. I would recommend this business to anyone with a large or small job.

reviews.author: robert Ivan
reviews.text: Wayne’s did a professional job removing a sick and dying tree in my backyard. Great work. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Phyllis Mccoy
reviews.text: Wayne's tree service came promptly for an estimate. they removed a huge oak tree and trimmed several other trees. job was done as planned. the workers were professional, worked as a team and left the whole area very clean.. I would highly recommend Wayne tree service, excellent company and reasonable pricing. Thanks Phyllis

reviews.author: Jacob Schenkman
reviews.text: Dylan and his team provided exceptional service. I had various tree branches, bushes, and shrubs removed, and the team took care of everything including debris removal and cleaning up the property. Dylan and his team were courteous and communicated with me throughout the job. I will be reaching out to Dylan again in the future and highly recommend working with Wayne’s Tree Service.

reviews.author: Greg Thompson
reviews.text: Great service, very good prices. Wayne's has taken down several trees for me as well as some pruning. Professional service. Would highly recommend for any tree work.

reviews.author: Nancy Feusse
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Wayne’s Tree Service taking down a huge old willow that was overhanging our neighbors fence/yard. The work was done quickly, properly, with great care at an affordable price. The clean up was complete, no scraps left anywhere. Two thumbs up!

reviews.author: Mike Kucsan
reviews.text: I am getting my roof redone, and had a tree next to my house, which needed to be removed prior. I called Wayne's Tree service and Dylan came out and gave me an estimate. Price was on point, so we scheduled the work. April showers happened, so we delayed the work, to make sure the yard was not destroyed as they needed to bring in the big bucket truck. They came back out the day prior to assure the ground was in good enough shape, which it was. Wayne's Tree service did an amazing job on a challenging tree removal along with multi stumps to be ground up. Cleaned up the areas and left minimal trace on the property. Communication, price, quality of work, and cleanliness was top notch and will be using them again! Thank You!!!!!

reviews.author: D Winston
reviews.text: Wayne’s Tree Service did an excellent job! They removed two large spruce trees for us. The quote was very fair, and they were able to schedule the job the very next day. They clearly communicated what time they would arrive and followed through exactly as promised.

reviews.author: Jim B.
reviews.text: I've used Wayne's twice and will continue to use them for my tree removals. One of the trees was in a tough location (sandwiched between my house and neighbors) and no issue bringing it down. They cleaned up everything, arrived at the agreed time and the price was fair, as I recall.

reviews.author: ron P
reviews.text: Thank you Dylan and your crew. You guys saved our boy’s two year old birthday party!! They’re professional and trustworthy!! They did exactly what we talked about in the contract and more!! My wife and I were afraid we couldn’t get the big oak removed that had fallen during the wind storm because our yard was so soft and wet from the winter and rain. They accepted the challenge and exceeded our expectations. We highly recommend this company and needless to say…they’re the only company we’ll call for future tree service!!

reviews.author: Denise Schreck
reviews.text: Wayne's tree service was great! We had an old growth oak tree fall in our yard after a big storm. Wayne's tree guys showed up and quickly removed it!

reviews.author: GEORGE PALKO
reviews.text: I have used Wayne’s tree service several times over the years. I have had nothing but an excellent experience with them. This includes price and service and communication. I don’t think you need to look any further than Wayne’s if you have any tree issues at your property.

reviews.author: Zach
reviews.text: I had a large oak tree removed right by the power lines, and a few oaks pruned. Dylan was great to work with, from providing a quick estimate to scheduling and performing the work. The crew did a professional job at a good price. I switched from a larger company to Wayne’s and will continue to use them in the future.

reviews.author: Ben Macey
reviews.text: Excellent crew that expertly lollipopped a huge oak to get it above my power lies. They also pruned a silver oak for me. The work was professional and the cleanup was perfect. Highly recommend Wayne's.

reviews.author: Roger Boone
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Wayne's Tree service. Responded promptly to our request for tree removal and stump grinding and gave an estimate the same day. The estimate was reasonable and the work was scheduled within a week. They showed up on time and the job was done quickly and professionally. Everything looks great! Happy with the work they did!

reviews.author: Jeff Manalo
reviews.text: I initially hired Wayne’s Tree Service to remove a tree and grind the stump at a very reasonable price. However, due to changing circumstances, we decided to have the tree trimmed instead on the day Dylan and his team arrived. Dylan was incredibly accommodating, adjusting the original price to reflect the change in scope. The team did an excellent job, and I will definitely reach out to them again in the future.

reviews.author: Eugene Krel
reviews.text: We needed to remove a tree near the road and power lines. Dylan gave us a very reasonable quote and was extremely accommodating with scheduling to avoid working when the lawn was wet. The day of the job the team arrived on time and efficiently took the tree down. We are very happy with the service.

reviews.author: Alyssa Kuklo
reviews.text: I would hire Dylan and his crew anytime we needed a tree taken down or pruned. They were so helpful, worked efficiently and quickly! We couldn’t say enough nice things about Wayne’s tree service.

reviews.author: Gary Brenner
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Wayne's Tree Service. They are very responsive and dependable. They also do great work at a great price. If you need any tree service, I can't recommend Wayne's enough.

reviews.author: Alex Lopes
reviews.text: Excellent service! Dylan was a breeze to work with and went above and beyond making sure schedules would not clash between the tree cutting and a separate contractor I had scheduled. The quoted price was fair, scheduled quickly, and the tree - which was close to my house - was chopped down and stump grinded expertly. Very professional, great communication and highly recommend for your tree service needs

reviews.author: Cheryl Hart
reviews.text: Solid customer service and workmanship. In days where at times it is tough to get calls returned, Wayne’s returns calls and gives timely estimates with reasonable prices. Came to do work and was a job well done.

reviews.author: Vincent Fernicola
reviews.text: Awesome experience using Wayne's Tree Service. Removed two dead tress around powerlines to the house with no issues. Quick, and clean up was great! Reasonable price. Takes care to protect the lawn. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Liam Campbell
reviews.text: Excellent experience working with Dylan and the team. Dylan was very knowledgeable and made everything simple and stress-free. Great service all around, and I’ll be using them again.

reviews.author: Jonathan Tarella
reviews.text: I had a very tall pine tree next to my house that needed to come down. You could actually see the roots lifting up the ground around it in strong winds. We called up Wayne's, and Dylan swung by later in the morning to give us an estimate. He said he'd get us on that week; it turned out he and a big crew could just do it before lunch the next day. They cut it down, cleaned everything up, and were gone in 90 minutes, all for a fair price and with great communication. No hassle + no more worrying about a tree falling on my house = a happy customer.

reviews.author: Peg
reviews.text: Waynes tree service does the job RIGHT, They do exactly what they are supposed to do. They know about different trees and never keave a mess, I would suggest you call Waynes Tree Service for all your tree work.

reviews.author: Keith Harmon
reviews.text: I am a repeat and highly satisfied customer of Wayne’s Tree Service. Dylan and Pete are a pleasure to work with and are very professional. They are very responsive and communicate well and promptly. Their work is outstanding and timely. They took great care of my house and property. Their pricing is very fair. I highly recommend Wayne’s Tree Services. I would not hesitate to use these guys next time I need tree work

reviews.author: Evan Curry
reviews.text: These guys came out on time and did a great job removing and pruning some trees on my property. All the work was done exactly as we had discussed during the estimate. The crew were all very friendly and professional. I would use Wayne's Tree Service again.

reviews.author: Michelle McCann
reviews.text: We are so happy with our service from Wayne's Tree Service. Dylan came out within days of my request for an estimate and he arrived early the day of the job to walk our property and go over everything with me again that they were doing for us (pruning, stump grinding, and removing branches on some larger trees). Our yard was cleaned up neatly at the end. Thank you for the great work!

reviews.author: Steve Skakum
reviews.text: Wayne’s Tree Service is highly recommended. They removed 2 maples, cleaned up 2 large oaks, and ground many stumps on our property. Professional experience and a great crew all around. Very reasonably priced for the value they offer - they even brought me back wood chips for free the next day after I changed my mind about keeping them. Very happy with this company!

reviews.author: elizabeth ensminger
reviews.text: Great local company for tree removal and pruning. Professional crew pays attention to detail and thoroughly cleans up after all work is completed.

reviews.author: Karina Sherman
reviews.text: Excellent service! Came out promptly for estimate. Great communication throughout. Text updates and set up cones the night before to block parking. Took down three 60 ft. old trees from between houses like a champion! Would highly recommend for your tree service needs.

reviews.author: Michael Mizov
reviews.text: Dylan, the owner of Wayne's Tree Service returned my call the next day, came out on my schedule, gave me an estimate, then had the trees down and cleaned up before lunch the next day. His crew was very personable, professional, and hard working. Everything was done safely and I had some mulch from the stump grinding afterwards. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Frank Dell'Orto
reviews.text: Wayne's recently removed a rather large tree from our property. After a problematic experience with a different tree service, they were absolutely a breath of fresh air. Professional, responsive, cordial, and we were very pleased with the price. They did the job well, and did not leave a mess. Can't ask for more than that! Would definitely call on Wayne's again for any future tree needs.

reviews.author: David P
reviews.text: Had someone come out for an estimate for two tree removals along fence lines and dead branches removed from a large tree near the house. Was quoted a very fair price. I was told they would be there early in the morning and they were on site and ready to work by 8am. We walked the scope of the work order to make sure we were in the same page and they got right to work. It was quick, efficient and the cleanup was fantastic. You couldn’t tell there were trees down in my yard when they left. The gentleman that went up the trees to cut them down brought them with precision and care. He managed to miss two sheds, a patio and a deck in my small back yard with every branch he cut. Very impressive. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing tree services.

reviews.author: Zaw Win
reviews.text: Removed a large tree leaning towards the house and electrical wires. Overall great service, communication and skill. Fair price, fast turnaround time, easy to work with, and did a great job of taking care of the property. Highly recommend and would use their services again.

reviews.author: JERRY INNELLA
reviews.text: They were very careful of structures under the 2 trees they removed. Very neat and clean work. Strongly recommend them

reviews.author: Peter Spilletti
reviews.text: Dylan/Pete and team were tremendous to work with. I used them to cut down 4 trees and remove 6 stumps total from my property. They did a great job with the cleanup and very happy with the work they did removing everything in a timely manner. Would definitely use their service again

reviews.author: Ann Marie Juszczak
reviews.text: Wayne’s Tree Service was at our house on 9/23/19 to remove several trees and trim several others. Some of the trees were tall and inside our pool fence. They also had to come up our neighbors driveway to remove and trim others. They did an excellent job on everything, doing just what we asked. When they left, they cleaned up so well you would never know they were ever here. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Earl Richards
reviews.text: The storm had torn big branches from the trees in my backyard. I called Wayne's Tree Service and met with them the next day. While there I also asked for a small tree to be taken down and to prune the front trees The estimator was professional and gave me a quote for it all. They then called me to give me a time when they could do the job. They showed up right on time. they did exactly wanted I wanted. The crew was very pleasant. The job was done with professionalism and in a timely manner. I would recommend them.

reviews.author: Marcia Walker
reviews.text: Dylan and the crew of Wayne's Tree Service did outstanding work removing a tree from our front yard. They were on time, worked carefully and left everything clean! I would highly recommend Wayne's Tree Service!

reviews.author: Vincent Russo
reviews.text: Fast and reasonable estimate. Good communication. Work was done with care and quality. Would definitely recommend for any tree services and will be using them in the future. Thanks to Dylan and the crew for helping me out.

reviews.author: sarah kelly
reviews.text: I have used Wayne’s tree service twice now. Dylan is great. Super responsive and very easy to work with. He is thorough and has a great team. I would absolutely use them again!

reviews.author: Yessi GC
reviews.text: Highly recommend these guys ! Just had 2 trees removed Not only they gave me a great price they were very professional ! Thank you !

reviews.author: Stacy Snell
reviews.text: A tree fell onto our house in yesterday's storm. They responded immediately. The work to remove the tree was done very quickly. There was not a twig left on the ground when they were done. Price was reasonable. I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Traci Vicaro
reviews.text: Dylan and his crew were prompt, professional, and courteous. The cost to take down my large oak tree was also reasonable. I highly recommend Wayne’s Tree Service!

reviews.author: Craig Butler
reviews.text: Highly recommended. We recently hired Wayne's Tree Service to remove multiple large trees and prune a few others. The entire experience, from the outset of receiving a quote to the completion of the job, was both timely and professional. The job was completed exactly as agreed upon and to our complete satisfaction.

reviews.author: Lynne Fine
reviews.text: We have used Wayne’s tree service on 2 occasions. They were removing trees across the street from us and we asked for an estimate to remove 5 diseased trees and grind down the stumps. The price was so reasonable that we had them do it on the spot. They cleaned everything up and you could hardly tell that the trees were even there. We also recently used them to trim 6 trees around the house. I had been thinking of taking down one big tree because it was making one part of our deck unusable. They found a solution so that we can access the deck, but maintained the health and symmetry of the tree. I highly recommend Wayne’s Tree Service!

reviews.author: Barbara Flaherty
reviews.text: I just had a large tree trimmed by Wayne's Tree Service. From the initial visit for the estimate to the final clean-up the service was responsive and professional. And they did exactly what I wanted...the tree looks great! I highly recommend Wayne's Tree Service!

reviews.author: Laura Bloodgood
reviews.text: Dylan and gentlemen who worked with him did a fantastic job! They did exactly what I asked for, cleaned up so well and did not rush! I would recommend this company again in a heart beat.

reviews.author: Jake Muck
reviews.text: Wayne's Tree Service came out to my property today and cut down 5 trees. Very professional, on time, cleaned up everything and excellent price. Would not hesitate to use them again.

reviews.author: Patti Hurley
reviews.text: Highly recommend Wayne’s Tree Service. Came and did the tree removal and major clean up over and above what was expected. Non stop work until the job was done. Very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Michael Roberts
reviews.text: This company exceeded expectations. I live on 1.26 acres of BRIDGEWATER wilderness and every year Mother Nature downs trees to big for me to tackle. In the past, I hired tree service companies that were over priced, unprofessional, and didn’t finish the job to specs. Wayne’s Tree service was more than reasonably priced and went above and beyond, professionally handling some really difficult projects. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Shad Hillsborough
reviews.text: Used Wayne’s twice now and the first tree was a complicated one growing around the power lines so some other tree removal businesses wouldn’t do it. Had no idea how much equipment and manpower was needed to remove a tree, was actually fun to watch. They even raked up any debris and used a blower. Total pros from start to finish.

reviews.author: Kira Brady
reviews.text: Wayne's Tree Service is amazing! Friendly, professional, excellent service. I will be calling them again! I have pin oaks that are 80-90 years old, and they took great care with the pruning.

reviews.author: Maureen Wilson
reviews.text: Wayne’s crew arrived as promised and removed a massive sick white ash that was in the middle of a grouping of bushes surrounded by a stone wall. The lawn was covered with plywood to protect from falling debris. The front windows were also shielded since the tree hunk over the roof. They were very careful in the placement of their bucket truck and how the limbs were carefully lowered to the lawn. It took most of the morning and into the afternoon to remove and clean the property. We were thrilled with the care that was taken to protect our home. We will be recommending the Somerville crew!!

reviews.author: T Yessman
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company! They were prompt in returning my phone call (same day), came out the next day and provided a thorough estimate, were very considerate about potential lawn damage (rescheduled due to rain), called the day before the job, showed up on time, crew worked very hard to get a big job done quickly, efficiently, and neatly. They provided the most affordable estimate.

reviews.author: Kyle
reviews.text: Wayne’s was very fair, honest and reasonable. Came when promised, fast and efficient and left my property cleaner than when they arrived. Great service couldn’t be happier would recommend

reviews.author: Jodi Dunkelman
reviews.text: Wayne's tree service did an excellent job taking down a bunch of trees. They show so much care and precision for every tree. It was great for my boys to watch and see the trees come down and how they worked together to stay safe :)

reviews.author: Ted lu
reviews.text: These guys worked so hard and so professionally. No drama in pricing quote. They came with all the professional tools and equipment that makes it safe for everyone. I’m the end of day the job was done flawless and safely. Would love to use them again.

reviews.author: Kenneth Romeo
reviews.text: Excellent Service. Pete And His Crew Did An Outstanding Job With Their Work And Cleanup. Pete Is Very Thorough With His Communication And Had No Issues Scheduling The Work. I Would Highly Recommend Wayne’s Tree Service.

reviews.author: Chris D
reviews.text: I had two very large trees that needed work do, and they came in and took care of it right away. Very reasonably priced and easy to work with, i will definitely be using them again.

reviews.author: Norm Graff
reviews.text: Very Happy with Wayne's Tree Service. They were very responsive, showed up when they said they would be there, and performed a great job all around. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Diana Brownell
reviews.text: We highly recommend Wayne's Tree Service !! They removed 3 1/2 large maples and did an excellent job , even on the clean up. Crew was hard working, polite and professional .

reviews.author: Elizabeth Maggiore
reviews.text: Second time using Wayne's - they came and ground out a stump in the front yard. Came on time, were quick about it, cleaned up, and even spread out some "Raritan Seed" mix and told me to keep it damp. I kept it damp and now you can't even tell the tree was there at all. Frist time using them was to take down an 80 foot tall oak - WOW! They're very good at what they do!

reviews.author: Summer Cutler
reviews.text: They were very responsive, came out and gave me a quote within a day of me calling. Pricey, so I did not use them. But by far the easiest tree place in Somerset County to get a hold of.

reviews.author: Sandra Diez
reviews.text: Great service! They arrived on time, and they cleaned up the site after the removal of a tree. Would recommend.

reviews.author: J.T. Doscher
reviews.text: Wayne’s tree service was great. Upfront with information on what was needed for trees in the yard. Didn’t try to upsell you. Would use them again. Thank you!

reviews.author: Amelia Gubitosa
reviews.text: Dylan and his crew were professional, reliable and highly skilled. I would use them again if needed and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Lynn Romero
reviews.text: Was a difficult situation but they made the best of it and did a great job! They were all very nice respectful! They cleaned up very well! Will be calling them for a future job!

reviews.author: Joe Smith
reviews.text: Very unprofessional, when I called him he said he would handle a big tree removal that same day in a hour, then didn't show for the job. I called him and he kept saying he'll be there and still never showed. Then stopped answering his phone. I would not recommend.

reviews.author: Krystle Pringle
reviews.text: They stopped to help me and my son on the side of the road when my car tire shredded and stayed to fix it for me. Extremely courteous and kind, I would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: JAMES JONES
reviews.text: I called for a price, and he was at my house within 30 minutes. The next day my problem tree was no more. A+ for Wayne's Tree Service.

reviews.author: Anthony Naples
reviews.text: Excellent service . Great crew clean and very professional. Would recommend them every time ....thanks

reviews.author: Clara R
reviews.text: Professional, timely and clear communication, and gets the job done! Recommended by a neighbor and would highly recommend their services to others.
